description: Permanently remove one or more of the reader's saved readings from their History. Takes an array so the Workspace's multi-select can delete a batch in one call rather than one round trip per row. Ids that don't exist (or belong to someone else's history) are silently skipped — the response's `deleted` count says how many rows actually went, never assume it equals the number of ids you sent.

ids.description: Reading ids from list_readings. A single-item array deletes one row.

name: delete_reading

available.description: False when there is no signed-in reader or the store failed.
